**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 105 **Price** 180 gp **Ammunition** rounds (1 sp for 10, L Bulk) --- **Usage** mounted (black powder) **Space** 8 feet long, 6 feet wide, 6 feet high **Crew** 1 to 4 **Proficiency** martial --- **AC** 16 **Fort** +10 **Ref** +4 **Hardness** 5 **HP** 35 **Immunities** object immunities --- **Speed** 20 feet (pulled or pushed) --- Also known as an organ gun, a ribauldequin consists of a row of gun barrels set parallel on a frame so that they resemble the pipes of a large organ. Time-consuming to load but highly effective against enemy personnel, the ribauldequin is more at home on the battlefield than behind fixed fortifications. The standard organ gun has twelve barrels, firing a spread that covers a significant area.
**Aim** rotate 45°
**Load** ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) 4 times
**Launch** ([attack](/Traits.aspx?ID=540), manipulate) 5d6 piercing, 30-foot [cone](/Rules.aspx?ID=2386), DC 18 Reflex
